title: Removed plug-in function call
description: Error-prone rule — plug-in function calls whose documentation marks the function as removed (verbatim status from the MBS docs mirror via reference/plugin_spec.duckdb, with the removal release in 'removed_in'). Unlike deprecated functions, these calls fail with any current plugin version: the function no longer exists. Includes one-level custom-function wrappers (via_custom_function) and layout/field calculation usages (evidence_kind='layout'). Unresolved functions of a known plugin are surfaced by the deprecated sibling rule (plugin_deprecated_call), not here — this rule stays strictly removed-only so an error finding always means a real runtime defect. This is the maintenance axis, not the platform axis.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A removed plug-in function no longer exists in current plugin releases — the call fails at runtime. The status and removal release are verbatim vendor statements from the documentation mirror.
rule.remediation: Migrate the call to a current function (see the vendor's removal note per row), or pin the deployment to a plugin release older than the removal version — pinning trades one defect for growing maintenance debt.
